probe.text_sample: Veil Obscura - An abstract record of one of Australia’s most extraordinary natural events. | Veil Obscura VEIL OBSCURA documents the 2025 filling of Kati Thanda - Lake Eyre, the lake's most significant transformation in over fifty years. Kati Thanda - Lake Eyre rests below sea level and the imprint of an ancient ocean endures beneath the crust. Most years it remains silent, a vast plain of reflection without water.
